text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. To prepare for the 
formidable rivals ahead, she sought to 
elevate her skills even further during the 
camp. However—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew...! How was my time, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Any words of "Mission accomplished" were 
drowned out by the shrill screams...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Target accomplished," they would say, but 
those words were drowned out by the shrill 
screams...

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since you entered the Classic Year, 
your performances have been more and more 
incredible, haven't they!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We're super lucky to do summer training 
camp together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her success throughout the 
Classic year, Fuji Kiseki's already 
immense popularity soared to astronomical 
heights.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Usually there's a leader-type 
girl who keeps them in check, though.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, but no one else is training right 
now, so just watching should be totally 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days of summer training camp 
carried on amidst a chorus of swooning 
cheers—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Well, it's about time for a break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadada!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai! I bought the magazine you're 
on the cover of! The interview was 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, no way! Even though it was sold out 
everywhere!?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I'm super-duper excited for the Senior 
Class too~! Seeing you shine is 
practically what I live for, Senpai~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um...! Ponies, please calm down a little?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki was quickly getting buried 
under the bustling swarm of juniors. Just 
as I opened my mouth to stop them—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, you guys! Fuji's got a big 
race coming up! You're going way too far!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon, the spirited Umamusume 
serving as Miho's dorm leader, came by.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're not off the hook either, Fuji! 
Times like this, you've gotta lay down the 
law!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry. Thanks, Hishi Ama. I really 
was daydreaming a bit too much there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Little ponies! I'm super happy you're 
enjoying yourselves, but it's about time 
we focused on training!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's enough observing for now. Can you 
promise me that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fans
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the spirit! Look forward to 
the ultimate entertainment!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being popular is a wonderful thing, but... 
a twinge of unease lingered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone pins their hopes on Fuji 
Kiseki. They believe without a shadow of a 
doubt that she'll pull it off.
choice_data_list:
(I hope I'm not putting too much pressure 
on her)

(I hope I'm not putting too much pressure 
on her, though)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, as such worries continued to 
grow...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...You've been troubled by something 
lately, haven't you? That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? What's this? Is that something 
sparkling behind you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring my bewildered reaction, Fuji 
Kiseki reached her hand out toward my 
shoulder—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wah, what a surprise! What's a mysterious 
drink doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, she pulled out a brightly 
colored drink.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, just kidding! Aren't you thirsty?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You seemed a bit down lately, so I just 
wanted to cheer you up, even if only a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? If it's alright with you, 
won't you talk to me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems sharp-eyed Fuji Kiseki had seen 
right through it all along.
choice_data_list:
...I was worried you might be pushing 
yourself too hard.

...I was just worried you might be pushing 
yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Expectations from the public and the other 
Umamusume at the academy are higher than 
ever. When I asked if she wasn't pushing 
herself too hard—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Is that all? I was wondering why 
you seemed a little down lately.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, don't worry. If anything, I'm 
actually happy about it."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Both theater and magic only begin once 
all eyes are on you, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki continued, making a deliberate 
effort to sound gentle and composed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about what kind of scenery I can 
show everyone from here on makes me so 
incredibly excited!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So please, don't worry anymore. Thank you 
for thinking of me so much.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy it, along with my sincere 
apologies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a sip as prompted, a crisp, 
refreshing sweetness fills my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I haven't completely shaken off my 
anxiety, but... even so, dwelling on it 
forever will only make them worry about me 
instead.
choice_data_list:
(In that case, I'll believe in her and 
support her wholeheartedly.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if gently nudged by the sweet drink, my 
slight anxiety quietly faded away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. ...A smile really does suit you 
best.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oops, gotta go. The dorm leader meeting 
starts at 18:00.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I have some schedule matters to discuss, 
so I was hoping you could join us today, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, we don't have much time. Alright, 
let's use a shortcut!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll carry you, Trainer, and sprint all 
the way to the training camp!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Or there's a shortcut. It's a pretty 
steep slope, so it might be tough carrying 
them... But it should shave off a lot of 
time."
choice_data_list:
Take the shortcut down the steep hill to 
go home.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, okay! Make sure you hold on tight!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Tell me right away if you get scared, 
okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Fuji Kiseki's hard work, we 
somehow managed to make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it! Let's do our best together, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us dashed up a 
cliff-like, steep slope together—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Lend me a hand, Trainer! Watch your step, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Look! I can already see the lights!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Fuji Kiseki leading me by the hand, 
we managed to get back just in time!
